أستجدي (form X)
# أَسْتَجْدِي (ʔastajdī) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.diː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# أَسْتَجْدِيَ (ʔastajdiya) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.di.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
